content: Xoossay Nohera Caaqida Caaquwa
Xoossay Nohenne iya adde nayta haysada yaagidi anjis; “Yeletite, darite, sa7a ubbaa kumite.
Sa7aa do7ati, salo kafoti, biittan woxi qaaxiyabaynne abban de7iya moloti ubbay hintew yashshaninne dagaman de7o. Enti hintew haareto.
Taani doliya dumma dumma cil7obata hintew immidaysada, de7oy de7iya woxi qaaxiya medhetetha ubbay hintew kathi gidana mela immas.
Shin shempoy giddon de7iya gisho suuthi iya giddon de7iya asho moopite.
Oonika shempo wodhiday pirdetana. Qassi asa suuthi gussiya do7aka hayqon pirdana.
Xoossay ase bana daanisidi medhida gisho, asa suuthi gussiya oona gidikoka iya suuthayka asa kushen gukana.
Hinte yeletite, darite, hinte sheeshayka sa7a bolla daro” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Xoossay Nohenne iyara de7iya iya adde nayta haysada yaagis;
“Hiza, taani ta caaquwa hintera, hinte sheesharanne de7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbaara caaqayis.
Taani ta caaquwa kafotara, mehiyara, sa7a do7a ubbaaranne, markabiyape hintera keyida, de7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbara caaqayis.
Taani hintera caaqidaysa mela hizape de7oy de7iya medhetethati dhayo haathan dhayokona; ha sa7aaka zaari dhayo haathi dhaysena” yaagis.
Qassika Xoossay, “Taani taapenne hintefe, de7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbaafe giddon caaqiya caaquwa mallay haysa;
Taani ta zuulla shaaran essas. I taapenne sa7a bolla de7iya medhetetha giddon de7iya caaquwas malla gidana.
Ta saluwa shaara mayzida wodenne shaaran zuulli eqida wode,
taapenne hintefe giddon, de7oy de7iya dumma dumma medhetetha ubbaafe giddon caaqida ta caaquwa akeekana. De7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbaa dhaysanaw hizape guye dhayo haathi yeenna.
Zuulli shaaran eqida wode ta iya be7ada taapenne sa7a bolla de7iya dumma dumma medhetetha ubbaafe giddon caaqida merina caaquwa akeekana” yaagis.
Xoossay Nohe, “Taani taapenne sa7a bolla de7oy de7iyaba ubbaafe giddon caaqida caaquwa mallay haysa” yaagis.
Nohenne Iya Nayta
Markabiyape keyida Nohe adde nayti Seema, Kaamanne Yaafeta; Kaami Kanaane aawa.
Ha heedzati Nohe nayta; sa7a ubban de7iya asay entafe yeletidosona.
Nohey goshshancho; I woyne tokethan koyro asi.
Issi gallas Nohey he woyniyape uyidi mathotidi ba dunkaaniya giddon xire kallo zin7is.
Kanaane aawa Kaami ba aawa kalluwa be7idi, kare keyidi, ba nam7u ishatas odis.

Shin Seeminne Yaafeti afila ekidi, nam7ayka banta hashiyara hashiyara gathi oykidi, guye guthu hemeti gelidi, banta aawa kalluwa kammidosona. Enti banta aawa kalluwa be7oona mela banta ayfiya haraso zaaridosona.
Nohey mathoy aadhin, barkidi, iya kaalo na7ay oothidaba eris.
Nohey iyako,

content.text: I ba ishatas wursetha aylle gido”

content: yaagis.

content.text: Yaafeta sheeshay Seema sheeshara wolla de7onna;

content: Dhayo haathaafe guye, Nohey heedzu xeetanne ishatamu laythi de7is.
Nohey uddufun xeetanne ishatamu laythi de7idi hayqis.
